metadata.interval_scope: 95% paired Student t intervals. Do not cover calibration, demand, model-form or real-day uncertainty. Block intervals are pointwise; selected worst-block intervals are not selection-adjusted.
metadata.scope: Frozen selected packages only, PM peak. Independent seed variability under one fixed model; not an exhaustive full-hour or multi-period optimum.
metadata.score_scope: Production score and baseline noise band recomputed over confirmation seeds. No confidence interval is assigned to the nonlinear score or maximum block increase.

selectionProtocol.claims: Confirmation tests the primary core-score winners and strongest missed package only. Other objectives, non-dominated-set coverage, and full finite-space optimality remain screening-only findings.
selectionProtocol.selection: Before reading confirmation results, freeze the union of: (1) the valid package with highest final core score among beam-visited packages; (2) the valid package with highest final core score in the exhaustive set; (3) the valid nonempty package with highest final core score that the beam missed, if any. Break score ties lexicographically by frozen manifest-index vectors; deduplicate. The empty baseline, score zero, is eligible for (1) and (2) and is always run as the comparator. At most three nonempty packages plus baseline. No reselection on confirmation seeds.
